internal-api-golden-path v1.0 · owner lanes, gates, and the two hand-offs the Golden Path removes (struck through)

g.text: Hand-offs removed by the Golden Path
Firewall ticket: Azure Firewall rules for the pattern are pre-approved per spoke class
Security review: the template's controls evidence file replaces the review meeting
Before the Golden Path: two manual queues between intake and go-live. Target: same day to first deployment; conformance evidence written to the repo without a review meeting.
